# Potential

> Potential is an FF&E (Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment) procurement and supply
> chain management company. It acts as a single point of contact between owner,
> designer, contractor and a pre-selected network of Italian suppliers, covering
> Hospitality & Spa, Residential & Private, Government Buildings, Retail, Prime
> Property Sourcing and Yachting & Marine projects, plus a Digital Layer service
> line. Potential does not manufacture: it manages design intent, budget, tender
> and delivery across the supplier network.

## Contact
- Website: https://potential.contractors/
- Email: info@potential.contractors
- Founder: Carlo Casagrande, Founder and Design Manager
- Projects delivered worldwide

## Coverage areas
- **Hospitality & Spa** — Hotel & Resort, Spa & Wellness, F&B Spaces, Suite &
  Guestroom, Lobby & Public Areas
- **Residential & Private** — Villa & Private Home, Luxury Apartment, Penthouse,
  Interior Fit-out, FF&E Supply
- **Government Buildings** — Government Palaces, Parliament & Government, State
  Archives, Ministerial Offices, Consular & Official Residences, Ministries,
  Facades, Ceilings and Flooring
- **Retail** — Flagship Stores, Pop-up & Brand Activation, Shop-in-shop, Visual
  Merchandising
- **Prime Property Sourcing** — Ultra Prime Residential, Signature Residences,
  Bespoke Interiors. Focus on Milan, Italy
- **Yachting & Marine** — Superyacht Interior, FF&E Marine-grade, Custom Joinery,
  Upholstery & Fabric
- **Digital Layer** — Social Media Presence & Strategy, Enterprise E-Commerce &
  Digital Distribution, Customer Engagement & Loyalty Programs, Data &
  Performance Intelligence, Brand Strategy & Creativity, AI-Powered Process
  Automation

## Process
1. **Pre-Construction & Audit** — drawing and spec review, budget gap analysis,
   RFI risk log, value engineering
2. **Bid & Buyout** — RFQ and tender, subcontractor prequalification, procurement
   and bid leveling, cost engineering
3. **Engagement** — scope of work review, Schedule of Values, design-intent
   assurance, budget tracking
4. **Delivery & Site** — site inspections, progress meetings, change order log,
   escalation protocol
5. **Closeout & Turnover** — substantial completion, punch-list, as-built
   documentation, warranty and O&M manuals

## What differentiates Potential
- One single point of contact between owner, designer, contractor and supplier
- Direct access to a pre-selected panel of Italian manufacturers with certified
  quality and stated lead times
- Structured competitive tendering with like-for-like comparison
- Real-time budget control and change-order management before overruns occur
- Owner's Representative role on site visits and supplier negotiations
- Integrated technical expertise: drawing package review, MEP coordination,
  regulatory compliance

## Figures published by Potential
These are the company's own published figures, not independently audited:
- 50+ top-tier global clients on strategic design and supply projects
- 40+ international awards across hospitality, retail and brand
- 10+ years of experience on complex multi-sector projects
- €570K to €1.1M documented savings on a single €6M project
- 8-15% average tender savings on FF&E contract value
